purpose: Define `Hello` as the canonical rendezvous/discovery shared-service surface used to locate peers/services for subsequent direct transport establishment.

topics.name: Hello Identity
topics.purpose: Define `Hello` as the canonical rendezvous/discovery shared-service surface used to locate peers/services for subsequent direct transport establishment.

semantics.name: Hello
semantics.identity_rule: Hello service identity is explicit and separate from the identity of peers it helps discover.
semantics.bootstrap_rule: Hello exchanges only bootstrap/discovery metadata required to establish the next transport/session step.
semantics.payload_rule: Application payload is not semantically owned by Hello.
semantics.peer_rule: A discovered peer retains its own IdentityCore/external identity.
semantics.authority_rule: Discovery success never grants application/data authority.
semantics.transport_rule: Hello does not replace WebRTC or other negotiated peer transport.

invariants.rule: Hello/Rendezvous performs peer discovery/bootstrap only; it never becomes application-payload owner, semantic peer identity, or authorization authority.

hard_gates.condition: Hello becomes application payload relay by default
Hello service identity used as peer identity
peer identity inferred only from rendezvous session id
